fatal_blockers: P1: Under the standard binary Lawrence lift, every kernel vector u becomes (u,-u); iterating merely replicates it and doubles squared norm at each level. The matched replicated completeness cost scales identically, so lambda>mu cannot arise; any nonstandard target or metric is unspecified.

P2: The proposed Gram/center enumeration is infinite because coefficient and denominator bounds are absent, and the overlap glue, labels, target, and shell threshold are undefined. A fixed dimension-3--6 shell gap also cannot test the claimed polynomial family or prevent one malformed gadget from contributing only additive cost.

P3: Boundary maps, homology classes, and lookup-chain coordinates are linear, so the G13 integral affine combination lifts to the same boundary class whenever honest lifts do. Torsion order alone gives no Euclidean filling lower bound, and no explicit complex or defect map is frozen.

P4: Interval-product selectors, convolution tables, and representation coordinates remain a linear marginal hierarchy vulnerable to G15-style signed pseudodistributions; equal Frobenius norm does not enforce integrality. The six-layer program, transitions, rows, target, weights, control, and acceptance fiber are not fixed, so the proposed search permits cherry-picking and is not preregistered.

P5: Binary expander distance does not imply the claimed integer-fiber rigidity. Formal integral affine combinations of complete lifted encodings satisfy every linear Tanner marginal check, and testing unspecified 3-lifts of sizes one through three cannot discriminate an asymptotic norm-growth law.

P6: A Veronese lookup implemented by selector columns is still linear in unrestricted lattice coefficients; the G13 affine combination extends by applying the same coefficients to every honest bucket encoding. No splitter, bucket map, code, center, residual weight, or control objective is fixed, so the cost-216 search is not executable as stated.

P7: Valuations and carries amplify only nonzero defects; an exact signed pair-table lift has zero defect in every prime block. The selected pairs, Teichmuller tags, digit equations, factor, center, and completeness audit are unspecified, while G33 requires cosphericity to be certified before any shell claim.

Generation 15 verifies that those affine coefficients lift through every node of a full assignment hierarchy with exactly zero residual, defeating weighted ancestors below the declared threshold.

Generation 31 supplies only a finite one-copy pass; Generation 32 then verifies two compatible parity blocks of cost 432=2d1^2 despite 125 cross-copy moment rows. Thus additive replication, not superadditive growth, is the current evidence.
Generation 19 exhibits an exact accepting signed flow with two negative coefficients. No supplied verifier tests interval products or character blocks, so P4 has no evidence against that obstruction.

Generation 14's complete pair bags pass one finite shell, but Generation 28 has lambda=57/32<mu=2 and Generation 30 has an exact seed isometry. None of the proposed sparse or recursive replacements supplies a verified growth mechanism.

Generation 33 verifies failure of every 512 tested completeness sign rules for its nonlinear tag family, confirming that equal-radius assertions require an exact center/factor gate rather than informal constant-weight claims.
